about_the_game:
Build your team of survivors and the NPCs they befriend with the Doomsday Character Creator Kit 1! PVGames continues their Doomsday series with a massive pack of 100+ body and outfit images that you can layer to dress your characters up exactly how you imagine them. With bases, hair, tops, bottoms, accessories, weapons, and more, the men and women who survived the apocalypse will still be able to look good while staying safe. Start your players with a character who’s dressed in scraps and suffering from amnesia, and have them fight or scavenge their way into leather jackets or armored gear to make survival much more likely, and let your players decide whether their survivor uses pistols, axes, machetes, or shotguns in battle. Use the full body images with 16 poses to let your players see their characters close up during cutscenes, or use them for NPCs so your players can tell if their conversation is going well based on their expressions.

Walking sprites and portraits aren’t all you’ll find in this pack! Each sprite sheet comes with a ton of behaviors that you can grab to add even more life to your game, with resting poses, attacks, interactions, and more. Have NPCs stand around safe zones with different idle animations so they all feel different, and let your players climb, jump, sneak, and run to gather all the possible items they could need. And if a conversation goes south? Then have your survivors pull out their weapons on the map before the battle starts. Just because it’s the apocalypse doesn’t mean that nobody is around, so give your game some suitably grungy characters with the Doomsday Character Creator Kit 1!


Contents:

* 100+ body and outfit images
* All character pieces come in 8 directional facings
* Over 70 animations for the character sprites
* Total of nearly 2,500 frames of animation per piece
* 16 large character portraits for paperdolls, busts, face-sets, and more!


These character pieces are fully compatible with all other PVGames character pieces with the RPGTools asset label so you are free to mix and match and grow your extensive character piece library!

These tiles are fully compatible with all other PVGames tiles from the RPGTools line of assets.


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
